name: Direct Volume Rendering with Pre-integration
aliases: Pre-integrated Volume Rendering for Tetrahedral Meshes
definition: Renders the adapted tetrahedral mesh using direct volume rendering, accelerated by pre-integration computed in shaders.
summary: Direct Volume Rendering with Pre-integration renders unstructured tetrahedral meshes via GPU-accelerated raycasting, using pre-computed integral tables to handle geometric complexity beyond regular grids.
